title: Autopilot host config
description: Tells the host where and how to run. Lives at /etc/autopilot/host.json on the host.

name.description: Name of this host in the issue claim label autopilot:host:<name>. Default: the short hostname.

app_id.description: ID of the GitHub App that acts for autopilot.

secrets.description: 1Password references that the host reads with op when the service starts.

claude_token.description: Claude Code OAuth token for the agent containers.

owners.description: GitHub logins allowed to start a job by adding the autopilot label.

allow.description: Owners (an org or a user) and owner/repo entries that the host works on. The host ignores every other installation of the App. Change it with `autopilot allow` and `autopilot deny`.

docker.description: rootless: a Docker daemon for the autopilot user only. rootful: the system Docker, which gives the autopilot user root-level control of Docker.

concurrency.description: How many issues the host works on at the same time. Each one gets its own containers and `limits`, so size it to the host's memory and the rate limits of the agent's plan.

memory.description: Memory cap, as Docker reads it (for example 6g).

claude.description: Claude Code settings for the agent containers.

config.description: Personal Claude config, mounted read-only as the agent's ~/.claude: github.com/<owner>/<repo>[//<subdir>][#<ref>] (fetched per job with the App token, so the App must be installed on that repo) or an absolute path on the host.
